title: Final Statement, Credit Balance Refund and File Closing (Assisted Living)
content:
Closing an Assisted Living Residency and Care Agreement account rests on the following standards of the Business Office.

1. A final statement is issued no later than the final statement period (30 calendar days) after the vacate date.
2. A credit balance is refunded in one refund to the party who overpaid: an overpayment by a long-term care insurer is returned to that insurer, and any other credit balance to the resident, or to the estate when a date of death is on the customer profile.
3. A credit balance refund may be issued only while the residency is in vacated status.
4. The residency file may be closed only when the account balance is 0.00.

### Who receives the refund (hypothetical credit balances)

| Source of the credit balance | Date of death on the customer profile | Refunded to |
|---|---|---|
| Overpayment by the long-term care insurer | — | The insurer |
| Any other credit balance | No | The resident |
| Any other credit balance | Yes | The estate |

### Points of judgement

- Vacate date 12 August: the final statement is due no later than 11 September (hypothetical).
- A residency still in notice given status takes no credit balance refund.
- A balance of 0.01 after the refund keeps the file open; only a balance of 0.00 allows closing.
